biafo-hispar-snow-lake.title: Biafo-Hispar Snow Lake Trek - Guide to the Great Glacial Traverse - GB Guide
biafo-hispar-snow-lake.desc: The Biafo-Hispar Snow Lake trek: ~100km across one of the longest glacial systems outside the poles, ~20-22 days, serious mountaineering. Route, season, access.
hero_meta: Askole to Hispar, via Snow Lake

concordia.title: Concordia Trek - The Throne Room of the Mountain Gods - GB Guide
concordia.desc: The Concordia trek: up the Baltoro Glacier to the confluence below K2, Broad Peak and the Gasherbrums. Route, difficulty, best season and how to start.

gondogoro-la.title: Gondogoro La Trek - The High Pass from Concordia to Hushe - GB Guide
gondogoro-la.desc: The Gondogoro La trek: a technical ~5,585m pass linking Concordia to the Hushe Valley, with rope-and-harness glacier crossing. Route, difficulty, season, access.

haramosh-kutwal-lake.title: Haramosh & Kutwal Lake Trek - Moderate Karakoram Valley Walk - GB Guide
haramosh-kutwal-lake.desc: The Haramosh Kutwal Lake trek: a moderate, scenic walk up the Haramosh valley to an alpine lake beneath Haramosh peak. Route, difficulty, best season and access.

hushe-valley.title: Hushe Valley - Gateway to Masherbrum, Laila & Gondogoro - GB Guide
hushe-valley.desc: The Hushe Valley: the gateway village for Masherbrum, Laila Peak and the Gondogoro La. Day walks and base-camp treks, difficulty, best season and how to get there.

k2-base-camp.title: K2 Base Camp Trek 2026 - Complete Guide, Costs & Permits - GB Guide
k2-base-camp.desc: K2 Base Camp trek guide: 18-21 days on the Baltoro Glacier, 5,150m, permits, real costs, day-by-day itinerary. The world's greatest wilderness walk.

karambar-lake.title: Karambar Lake Trek - High Alpine Lake on the Ishkoman Edge - GB Guide
karambar-lake.desc: The Karambar Lake trek: a remote high alpine lake (~4,300m) on the Ishkoman/Chitral edge of Gilgit-Baltistan. Route, difficulty, best season and how to access it.

laila-peak-base-camp.title: Laila Peak Base Camp Trek - Hushe Valley Route in Baltistan - GB Guide
laila-peak-base-camp.desc: Laila Peak Base Camp trek guide: a moderate multi-day walk from Hushe village in Baltistan to a base camp around 4,200m beneath the scythe-shaped ~6,096m peak, with honest route, season and acclimatisation advice.

masherbrum-base-camp.title: Masherbrum Base Camp Trek - Hushe Valley Route Guide - GB Guide
masherbrum-base-camp.desc: Masherbrum (K1) Base Camp trek guide: a remote multi-day wilderness walk from Hushe village through the Ghanche valleys to base camp around 4,280-4,500m, with route notes and honest hazard advice.

naltar-lakes.title: Naltar Lakes Trek - Blue Lake Day Walk from Gilgit Guide - GB Guide
naltar-lakes.desc: Naltar Lakes guide: an easy jeep-and-walk day trek from Gilgit to the vivid Blue Lake and Bashkiri lakes, with route notes, season advice and honest logistics.

nanga-parbat-base-camp.title: Nanga Parbat Base Camp Trek - Fairy Meadows & Raikot Route Guide - GB Guide

nanga-parbat-base-camp.h1: Nanga Parbat Base Camp Trek Guide

nanga-parbat-rupal-face.title: Nanga Parbat Rupal Face Trek - Tarashing & Astore Route Guide - GB Guide

nanga-parbat-rupal-face.h1: Nanga Parbat Rupal Face Trek Guide

rakaposhi-base-camp.title: Rakaposhi Base Camp Trek - Minapin & Hopper Route Guide - GB Guide

spantik-base-camp.title: Spantik (Golden Peak) Base Camp Trek - Arandu & Chogo Lungma Route Guide - GB Guide
